description: This file is a header (.h) file for the Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics module, defining APIs for TR-069 device IP download diagnostics. It includes function declarations, macro guards, includes, and documentation for setting diagnostic parameters related to download tests such as DiagnosticsState, Interface, DownloadURL, EthernetPriority, and DSCP.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics_DiagnosticsState
methods.description: Sets the DiagnosticsState parameter indicating the state of the download diagnostics test (e.g., Requested, Completed, Error states).

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics_Interface
methods.description: Sets the network interface (e.g., Device.IP.Interface.1) over which the diagnostic test is performed.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics_DownloadURL
methods.description: Sets the URL (HTTP or FTP) from which the CPE downloads during diagnostics.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics_EthernetPriority
methods.description: Sets the Ethernet priority code for marking packets during the download diagnostic test.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_DownloadDiagnostics_DSCP
methods.description: Sets the DSCP value for marking packets during the diagnostic test.
